verdict.rationale: Parsec ships a Teams API for automating deployment, so a buyer could fairly ask for a sandbox or test environment to exercise it against, and the axis applies. The evidence documents no sandbox, test-mode, or isolated non-production environment. The 14-day free trial is a commercial trial of the full Teams plan, not an isolated sandbox, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
